title: The Poetaster
author: Ben Jonson
description: "The Poetaster" by Ben Jonson is a satirical comedy written in 1601.
longDescription: Set in ancient Rome with the poet Ovid as its principal character, the play became a key salvo in the War of the Theatres—a public feud between Jonson and rival playwrights John Marston and Thomas Dekker.

authorInfo.bio: Ben Jonson (–1637) wrote The Poetaster. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
